k: Humans altered long ago by Kree experiments
st: In season 2, Terrigen turns Skye into an Inhuman, and Jiaying leads the hidden people of Afterlife into a war with S.H.I.E.L.D.
In season 3, Terrigen spreads new Inhumans worldwide; the ATCU hunts them and Hive enslaves many, until Lincoln dies stopping him.
In season 4, Inhumans must register under the Sokovia Accords while the Watchdogs hunt them and Ivanov's LMDs plot their end.
In season 5, in 2091, the Kree breed Inhumans on the Lighthouse to sell as fighters, until Mack kills Kasius.
In season 7, Nathaniel Malick seizes Afterlife in the past, kills Jiaying and steals Inhuman powers, until Daisy ends him.

k: Blue-skinned aliens who made the Inhumans
st: In season 2, the Kree warrior Vin-Tak comes to Earth to destroy the Diviners and anyone they changed, until Sif takes him home.
In season 3, Hive uses an ancient Kree beacon to lure two Kree Reapers to Earth, and destroys one of them.
In season 5, in 2091, Kasius and his Kree rule the Lighthouse and the last humans, until Mack kills Kasius.

k: Synthetic aliens who can pass for humans
st: In season 5, Enoch, a Chronicom anthropologist posing as a human, sends Coulson's team to 2091 to save the world.
In season 6, a Shrike plague destroys Chronyca-2, and Chronicom Hunters seize ships and hunt Fitz for the secret of time travel.
In season 7, Sibyl's Chronicoms travel through time to erase S.H.I.E.L.D., until May and Kora fill their army with empathy.

k: Alien parasites that infect hosts and destroy worlds
st: In season 6, Izel's Shrike parasites take hosts across Earth, until May kills Izel and Mack closes the portal to her people.
In season 5, Qovas sends Remorath warriors into the Lighthouse after S.H.I.E.L.D.'s gravitonium, and his ship is destroyed.
In season 5, in 2091, Vrellnexians prowl Earth's ruins; Kasius looses some on the Lighthouse, and Flint, Mack and Yo-Yo stop them.

k: Thor's people, from the realm of Asgard
st: In season 1, Loki brings Asgard's army to Earth to avenge Thor, captures Hank Pym, and stays to rule humanity until he is beaten.

k: Giants of the frozen realm Jotunheim
st: In season 1, Odin returns baby Loki to Laufey and makes peace, and Prince Loki leads Frost Giants to Thor's party on Earth.
In season 3, Laufey hunts Howard and Darcy's egg when they hide with Loki on Jotunheim, until the egg subdues every pursuer.

k: The people of Xandar, home of the Nova Corps
st: In season 2, Xandar seals itself behind a planetary shield against Ronan, and Nebula stops Nova Prime from surrendering it.
In season 2, Ronan overthrows Thanos and besieges Xandar, until the planet's shield crushes the Dark Aster and kills him.

k: Odin's people, from the realm of Asgard
st: In season 2, Odin banishes Hela, then hands her Asgard's throne, and she unites its armies with the Ten Rings to free the realms.
In season 2, Thanos attacks Gamora's people, and Hela leads the armies of Asgard and the Ten Rings to their rescue.

k: Kaiju spawned by the gamma-born Apex
st: In season 3, the Apex spawns gamma monsters that kill the Avengers; after Mega-Hulk kills it, he leads the rest to his island.

k: Immortals who answer to the Celestial Arishem
st: In season 3, Agatha takes the powers of every Eternal but Kingo, then frees them once she defeats Arishem with Kingo's help.

k: Cosmic giants who are born inside planets
st: In season 3, Agatha drains Tiamut, buried in Earth's core, and becomes a Celestial to defeat Arishem when he comes to end Earth.

k: Cosmic beings sworn only to observe the multiverse
st: In season 3, the Eminence and two other Watchers put Uatu on trial for interfering, and Strange Supreme strips their powers.

k: The infected, hungry for the living
st: In season 1, a quantum virus brought back by Hank Pym and Janet van Dyne turns most of Earth, Avengers included, into zombies.
Five years on, the Queen of the Dead's hordes overrun the North Institute and New Asgard, and the Nova Corps quarantine Earth.
Infected Talokanil, led by a zombie Namor, attack the Raft, until Kamala's group kills Namor and the Raft sinks.
Skrull bandits roam the zombie-ruled wasteland and attack Shang-Chi's group, who fight them off.

k: Asgard's people, sheltering in New Asgard
st: Valkyrie's Asgardians shelter in New Asgard, until Wanda's food, made of zombie flesh, infects them.
